data.body: Investigation complete (inline fallback — bot-psychologist SUB-AGENT-GUARD blocks nested dispatch). Root cause: Instruction Locality (#16 in bot-psychologist taxonomy). The feasibility-reviewer procedure and brainstorm skill both lack any instruction requiring per-command (per-subcommand) empirical verification of CLI tool invocations. The rule does not exist at the execution sites. Three structural gaps confirmed via static analysis: GAP1 — feasibility-reviewer.md Step 1 asks for 'the specific capability the epic assumes' at an integration-feature level, not per-command. No step requires enumerating ACLI subcommands or capturing observed flags/payload shapes. GAP2 — researchFindings schema (post-scrutiny-handlers.md) has no command_surface field; only (capability, status) tuples are recorded, so per-command contract is not durable even if the reviewer did empirical testing. GAP3 — preplanning research-process.md verifies via WebSearch but has no cross-reference checking that a per-command contract exists in researchFindings before implementation stories proceed. testing_mode=RED. RED test file: tests/skills/test-feasibility-per-command-contract.sh (6 tests, all FAIL).
